basic_info.description: Welcome to this stunning Edwardian home featuring 4-bdrm, 3.5-bath, 4,368 sq ft residence artfully combining classic charm with contemporary elegance.  Nestled on a 30' wide lot, the fully detached home is filled with natural light, offering space & tranquility. High ceilings and large windows create a bright, airy atmosphere. Gleaming hrdwd floors and traditional details evoke timeless style.  The main level, ideal for entertaining, boasts a grand foyer, sophisticated living room w/ a marble fireplace, and a refined dining room featuring original built-in glass-front cabinets. The kitchen/family room includes a casual dining space and TV room that open to a deck.  Upstairs, the primary suite is a luxurious retreat w/ a walk-in closet and Carrera marble bath, while 2 additional bdrms share a convenient hallway bath. The top floor offers impressive views of the neighborhood and The Presidio, providing versatile space for a playroom, office, or media room.  The lower level features an intimate gathering space with a wet bar, French doors to the yard, a guest bdrm, office, and a full bath. A 2-car garage with EV charger completes this impressive home. Situated in a welcoming neighborhood with easy access to SF's cultural highlights and outdoor adventures. https://1638lakest.com/mls
